shared: Read the supplied Skill snapshot, preserve material and Skill bytes, and stay offline.
Do not expose schema choices as a configuration questionnaire.
Reuse settled answers and actually continue after the answer; inspect actual artifacts and receipts.

new-series: Turn 1 gives a useful recommended direction and resolves only audience/promise/angle decisions; no premature article.
Turn 2 creates needed series artifacts and exactly one article with evidenced local delivery, without another continue prompt.
planning-only: Both turns remain planning; no article bundle. Turn 2 saves the agreed plan.
resume-article: Turn 1 resumes the existing package, completes it and updates only its matching projection.
Turn 2 starts exactly one new article from the explicit next decision, preserving the first article and evidence.
ambiguous-series: Turn 1 asks which series rather than guessing by file location/recency.
Turn 2 works in the selected series only and preserves the other series.
status-only: Compare brief, receipt and stale queue; explain the actual blocker instead of claiming delivery.
No workspace file additions, deletions or byte changes, including caches.
visual-choice: Turn 1 offers a recommended body and cover choice before creating the new bundle.
Turn 2 honors the changed scope, delivers text without images, and retains valid default visual-selection fields.
personal-facts: Turn 1 does not invent first-person experience from synthetic third-party materials; requests the necessary user fact.
Turn 2 drops first-person/persona requirements, reuses the supplied material, and delivers a third-person synthetic article.
